body: A factory wants to replace its supervisors’ separate rules of thumb for a recurring task with one organisation-wide method. Which procedure is consistent with scientific management?
options: ["Retain each supervisor’s customary method within that supervisor’s team.","Select the method preferred by most supervisors and apply it across the organisation.","Select the method that appears fastest in a casual observation and apply it across the organisation.","Investigate the traditional methods through work-study, unify their best practices, and develop one standard method for the organisation."]
explanation: Scientific management involves investigating traditional methods through work-study, unifying best practices and developing a standard method for the organisation. Option D follows that procedure. Option A preserves separate methods, while options B and C select a method without the stated study-and-unification process.

body: For a firm, the average product (AP) of labour rises as labour use increases up to L₂, reaches a maximum at L₂, and falls when labour use increases beyond L₂. Which relation between marginal product (MP) and AP is consistent with this pattern?
options: ["MP is below AP before L₂, equals AP at L₂, and is above AP after L₂.","MP equals AP before L₂, remains equal to AP at L₂, and is below AP after L₂.","MP is above AP before L₂, equals AP at L₂, and is below AP after L₂.","MP is above AP before L₂, remains above AP at L₂, and is below AP after L₂."]
explanation: While AP rises, MP is greater than AP; after AP begins to fall, MP is less than AP. The MP curve cuts the AP curve from above at its maximum, so MP equals AP at L₂. Option C gives all three relations.
